CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW l1_inspection_cycle_nelson_view AS
WITH starts AS (
    SELECT timestamp AS start_time FROM process_metrics
    WHERE station_name = 'l1_inspection'
      AND metric_name = 'inspection_gantry_positioning_time'
),
ends AS (
    SELECT timestamp AS end_time FROM process_metrics
    WHERE station_name = 'l1_inspection'
      AND metric_name = 'inspection_pallet_releasing_time'
),
cycle_pairs AS (
    SELECT s.start_time, MIN(e.end_time) AS end_time
    FROM starts s
    JOIN ends e ON e.end_time > s.start_time
    GROUP BY s.start_time
),
cycle_time_calc AS (
    SELECT cp.start_time AS time, SUM(p.value) AS value
    FROM cycle_pairs cp
    JOIN process_metrics p
        ON p.timestamp >= cp.start_time
       AND p.timestamp <= cp.end_time
       AND p.station_name = 'l1_inspection'
    GROUP BY cp.start_time
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT SUM(mean) AS mean, SQRT(SUM(std_dev * std_dev)) AS std
    FROM baseline_metrics
    WHERE station_name = 'l1_inspection'
      AND metric_name != 'inspection_idle_time'
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT
        ct.time, ct.value,
        b.mean, b.std,
        b.mean + 2.5 * b.std AS upper_2_5sigma,
        b.mean - 2.5 * b.std AS lower_2_5sigma,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ct.time) AS rn
    FROM cycle_time_calc ct CROSS JOIN baseline b
),
rules AS (
    SELECT *,
        -- Rule 1: single point beyond 3σ
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1_trigger,

        -- Rule 2: 9 consecutive same side
        CASE WHEN
            (value > mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,5) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w > mean)
        OR  (value < mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,5) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w < mean)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2_trigger,

        -- Rule 3: 6 consecutive trending
        CASE WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        OR  (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3_trigger,

        -- Rule 4: 14 alternating
        CASE WHEN
            (SIGN(value - LAG(value,1) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,12) OVER w - LAG(value,13) OVER w))
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule4_trigger,

        -- Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5_trigger,

        -- Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6_trigger,

        -- Rule 7: 15 consecutive within 1σ
        CASE WHEN
            ABS(value - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,1) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,2) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,3) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,4) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,5) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,6) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,7) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,8) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,9) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,10) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,11) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,12) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,13) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,14) OVER w - mean) < std
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule7_trigger,

        -- Rule 8: 8 consecutive beyond 1σ either side
        CASE WHEN
            ABS(value - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,1) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,2) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,3) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,4) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,5) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,6) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,7) OVER w - mean) > std
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8_trigger
    FROM ordered
    WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),
backfilled AS (
    SELECT *,
        rule1_trigger AS rule1,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule2_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 8 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule3_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 5 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule4_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 13 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule4,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule5_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule6_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 4 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule7_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 14 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule7,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule8_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 7 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8
    FROM rules
),
final AS (
    SELECT *,
        (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation
    FROM backfilled
)
SELECT
    time, value, mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma,
    any_violation,
    rule1, rule2, rule3, rule4, rule5, rule6, rule7, rule8,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,
    CONCAT_WS(' | ',
        CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Extreme Outlier Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Process Shift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Process Drift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Unstable Oscillation Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Early Warning: Shift Developing' END,
        CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Gradual Drift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Abnormal Stability Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'High Variability Detected' END
    ) AS violated_rules
FROM final
ORDER BY time;

        bm.mean - (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS lower_2_5sigma,

    JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm
      ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name
    WHERE pm.station_name = 'l1_inspection'
      AND pm.metric_name = 'inspection_core_vision_system_time'
),
rules AS (

        -- Rule 1: single point beyond 3σ
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1_trigger,

             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w < mean)

        CASE WHEN

             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        OR  (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3_trigger,

        -- Rule 4: 14 alternating
        CASE WHEN
            (SIGN(value - LAG(value,1) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w)) AND

            (SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,12) OVER w - LAG(value,13) OVER w))
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule4_trigger,

        -- Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5_trigger,

        -- Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6_trigger,

            ABS(LAG(value,2) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,3) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,4) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,5) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,6) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,7) OVER w - mean) > std
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8_trigger
    FROM ordered WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),

    SELECT *,
        rule1_trigger AS rule1,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule2_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 8 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2,

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW l1_inspection_inspection_post_vision_check_delay_view AS
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
        pm.timestamp AS time, pm.value,
        bm.mean, bm.std_dev AS std,
        bm.mean + (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS upper_2_5sigma,
        bm.mean - (2.5 * bm.std_dev) AS lower_2_5sigma,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.timestamp) AS rn
    FROM public.process_metrics pm
    JOIN public.baseline_metrics bm
      ON bm.station_name = pm.station_name AND bm.metric_name = pm.metric_name
    WHERE pm.station_name = 'l1_inspection'
      AND pm.metric_name = 'inspection_post_vision_check_delay'
),
rules AS (
    SELECT *,
        -- Rule 1: single point beyond 3σ
        (ABS(value - mean) > 3 * std) AS rule1_trigger,

        -- Rule 2: 9 consecutive same side
        CASE WHEN
            (value > mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,5) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w > mean
             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w > mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w > mean)
        OR  (value < mean AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,5) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,6) OVER w < mean
             AND LAG(value,7) OVER w < mean AND LAG(value,8) OVER w < mean)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2_trigger,

        -- Rule 3: 6 consecutive trending
        CASE WHEN
            (value > LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w > LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w > LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w > LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w > LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        OR  (value < LAG(value,1) OVER w AND LAG(value,1) OVER w < LAG(value,2) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,2) OVER w < LAG(value,3) OVER w AND LAG(value,3) OVER w < LAG(value,4) OVER w
             AND LAG(value,4) OVER w < LAG(value,5) OVER w)
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3_trigger,

        -- Rule 4: 14 alternating
        CASE WHEN
            (SIGN(value - LAG(value,1) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,1) OVER w - LAG(value,2) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,2) OVER w - LAG(value,3) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,3) OVER w - LAG(value,4) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,4) OVER w - LAG(value,5) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,5) OVER w - LAG(value,6) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,6) OVER w - LAG(value,7) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,7) OVER w - LAG(value,8) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,8) OVER w - LAG(value,9) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,9) OVER w - LAG(value,10) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,10) OVER w - LAG(value,11) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w)) AND
            (SIGN(LAG(value,11) OVER w - LAG(value,12) OVER w) != SIGN(LAG(value,12) OVER w - LAG(value,13) OVER w))
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule4_trigger,

        -- Rule 5: 2 of 3 beyond 2σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - 2*std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5_trigger,

        -- Rule 6: 4 of 5 beyond 1σ same side
        CASE WHEN
            (CASE WHEN value > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w > mean + std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        OR  (CASE WHEN value < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,1) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,2) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,3) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN LAG(value,4) OVER w < mean - std THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6_trigger,

        -- Rule 7: 15 consecutive within 1σ
        CASE WHEN
            ABS(value - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,1) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,2) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,3) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,4) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,5) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,6) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,7) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,8) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,9) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,10) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,11) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,12) OVER w - mean) < std AND ABS(LAG(value,13) OVER w - mean) < std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,14) OVER w - mean) < std
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule7_trigger,

        -- Rule 8: 8 consecutive beyond 1σ either side
        CASE WHEN
            ABS(value - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,1) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,2) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,3) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,4) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,5) OVER w - mean) > std AND
            ABS(LAG(value,6) OVER w - mean) > std AND ABS(LAG(value,7) OVER w - mean) > std
        THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8_trigger
    FROM ordered WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY rn)
),
backfilled AS (
    SELECT *,
        rule1_trigger AS rule1,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule2_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 8 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule2,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule3_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 5 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule3,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule4_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 13 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule4,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule5_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule5,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule6_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 4 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule6,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule7_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 14 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule7,
        CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rule8_trigger THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 7 FOLLOWING) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS rule8
    FROM rules
),
final AS (
    SELECT *, (rule1 OR rule2 OR rule3 OR rule4 OR rule5 OR rule6 OR rule7 OR rule8) AS any_violation FROM backfilled
)
SELECT time, value, mean, upper_2_5sigma, lower_2_5sigma,
    CASE WHEN any_violation THEN value ELSE NULL END AS anomaly_point,
    CONCAT_WS(' | ',
        CASE WHEN rule1 THEN 'Extreme Outlier Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule2 THEN 'Process Shift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule3 THEN 'Process Drift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule4 THEN 'Unstable Oscillation Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule5 THEN 'Early Warning: Shift Developing' END,
        CASE WHEN rule6 THEN 'Gradual Drift Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule7 THEN 'Abnormal Stability Detected' END,
        CASE WHEN rule8 THEN 'High Variability Detected' END
    ) AS rule_description
FROM final ORDER BY time;
